verdict.rationale: Mailgun's own SDK documentation says it offers a variety of official SDKs across multiple programming languages for sending, receiving, and tracking email. The evidence is only two brief first-party statements, so the depth of SDK coverage is unproven. Missing for 10: which languages are supported, links to official SDK repositories or package registries, SDK reference docs or code examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Mailgun offers a variety of SDKs designed to simplify email integration for developers.
Our SDKs support multiple programming languages, allowing you to seamlessly send, receive, and track emails within your applications.
